time.description: Array of start times in seconds.

duration.description: Array of box durations in seconds.

freq_min.description: Array of minimum frequencies in Hz.

freq_max.description: Array of maximum frequencies in Hz.

disjoint.description: Indicates whether all time-frequency boxes in the extent are non-overlapping.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether the boxes fully cover the time-frequency range without gaps.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.

min_freq.description: Lower bound of the frequency extent in Hz.

max_freq.description: Upper bound of the frequency extent in Hz.
